text:
emma: quick design pass — thinking about a 'compact' view for the routing policies editor (collapsible rule rows, denser padding) + live simulation inline. dropping screenshots in next msg. taylor: sounds good. main worry is discoverability of priority ordering if rows compress. maybe add a persistent header showing current sort order. rajesh: +1 on header. also keyboard affordance for moving rules up/down is critical for a11y. recommend `Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down` and visible focus ring. maria: copy note — current validation message says "Rule conflicts detected" which is vague. suggest "Conflicting rules: adjust priority or add a condition" so it's actionable. emma: agree on copy. for the compact rows I'm proposing a 40px height, show short labels: name, priority chip, enabled toggle, preview icon. full details expand. taylor: preview icon should open simulation drawer, not a modal. we want continuous context. :thumbsup: rajesh: accessibility nit — the drag handle needs `aria-label="Reorder rule"` and draggable list should announce position like "Rule 2 of 5" on focus. maria: validation UI: inline toast is noisy. instead surface a small warning pill next to the affected rule row + a summary in the header. clicking pill scrolls to the rule. emma: simulation panel idea: live tokenized example + a small config toggle ("fast sim" vs "accurate"). fast sim uses sample dataset, accurate runs full eval (longer). default to fast. taylor: UX microcopy for the sim toggle: label "Simulation mode" with helper text "Fast: approximate preview · Accurate: full evaluation (longer)" rajesh: quick keyboard snippet for aria:```html
Rule name
``` maria: tiny visual nit — priority chip colors need 4.5:1 contrast against chip background. current orange on white fails. emma: noted. I'll update the figma and push new screen. design-bot: uploaded compact-rows-v2.png to #design-assets. design-bot: file uploaded: compact-rows-v2.png (link) taylor: last question — should disabled rules be hidden from simulation by default? I think yes, but we should have a toggle in the sim panel: "Include disabled rules" (off). emma: agreed. I'll iterate on header summary text, validation copy, and aria details then reconvene tomorrow 10am. thanks all.
